comment: Model family profiles for universal GGUF loading. Sampling values follow each family's official model card / llama.cpp defaults; the router's AGENT role still enforces its own degeneration floors on top. Detected by GGUF architecture first, then filename patterns (see core/llm/model_profiles.py).

families.name: Google Gemma 4
families.notes: Official chat sampling: temp 1.0, top_k 64, top_p 0.95, repeat 1.0.

families.name: Google Gemma 3
families.notes: Gemma 3 card: temp 1.0, top_k 64, top_p 0.95, repeat 1.0.

families.name: Meta Llama
families.notes: Llama 2/3 card: temp 0.7, top_p 0.9, repeat 1.1. Context varies 4k-128k per version; the router reads the file's trained context.

families.name: Alibaba Qwen
families.notes: Qwen2.5 card: temp 0.7, top_p 0.8, presence 1.5 -> repeat 1.05. Qwen3 thinking models benefit from temp 0.6.

families.name: Mistral AI
families.notes: Mistral templates enforce strict user/assistant alternation; system text is folded into the first user turn. Card: temp 0.7, repeat 1.05.

families.name: Microsoft Phi
families.notes: Phi-3/4: temp 0.7 for chat; deterministic coding prefers lower. Small models: keep prompts tight.

families.name: Liquid AI LFM
families.notes: LFM2/LFM2.5 use a ChatML-like template: <|startoftext|><|im_start|>role\ncontent<|im_end|>. Official 8B-A1B card: temp 0.2, top_k 80, repeat_penalty 1.05. GGUFs without an embedded tokenizer.chat_template render via the 'chatml' format instead of llama-cpp-python's llama-2 <s>[INST] fallback (which made LFM echo <s> tokens in a loop).

families.name: DeepSeek
families.notes: R1 distills: temp 0.5-0.7, top_p 0.95, NO repeat penalty (harms reasoning chains). Thinking models get a larger token budget from the router.

families.name: TinyLlama
families.notes: 1.1B chat: tiny context, degenerates above temp 0.7; repeat 1.1 keeps it on rails.

families.name: HuggingFace SmolLM
families.notes: SmolLM2/3: temp ~0.6, top_p 0.8, repeat 1.05. Small models: repeat penalty essential.
